name: Threshold
tagline: The page is a heat grid of product by minute; the name is set on top of the silence.
summary: Every product writes into one full-bleed grid: four bands, one column per minute, lit in a single electric cyan when someone uses something Asgeir built. Three typefaces that clash on purpose (a wide grotesk, a condensed italic serif and a mono) sit on that grid with New Wave nerve and Swiss discipline underneath. Quiet minutes are drawn as honestly as busy ones, so the page shows real use without having to say so.
voice: Poetic and minimal: short, exact, a little amused by itself. "Each square is a minute. Each light, someone."
motion: Nothing moves unless something real happens or the cursor asks: a cell flashes when an event lands, the name gains weight near the pointer, and the theme crosses the page one column at a time.
sound: Opt-in Web Audio: a soft sine note per product on each live event (a pentatonic per row), a dry tick when the cursor crosses a cell, and a falling sweep of ticks as the theme crosses the page.
mark: Four right-aligned bars against a vertical 'now' line, their lengths taken from the last fifteen minutes of each product, so the logo (and the favicon) changes shape with the data.
